about_the_game:
Marktopia

Step into the fast-paced world of supermarket management!
Take control of a fully operational store — keep shelves stocked, set smart prices, and serve an ever-growing stream of customers. Every decision directly affects your profits and your shoppers’ satisfaction.

Market Tycoon brings a fresh take on classic market sims with its focus on smart planning, fast reactions, and smooth inventory control — no complicated systems, just pure management fun!

KEY FEATURES

🛒 Inventory & Pricing Control
Order products, place them on shelves, and set the right prices. Don’t let your shelves stay empty — every missed sale counts.

😊 Real-Time Customer Feedback
Track customer satisfaction by watching their facial expressions. Smiles mean success, frowns mean something’s wrong — fix issues before they grow.

🧼 Cleanliness Matters
Deploy your cleaners to keep your store spotless. Messy floors and dirty aisles will hurt your reputation and drive customers away.

🧍‍♂️ Cashier Management
Manage your cashiers effectively. Fast service reduces long lines and keeps your customers happy.

📈 Rising Challenge, Growing Crowd
As your store gains popularity, more customers will arrive — and so will the pressure. Can you keep everything running under control?
